FIELDS.NAME: Bright Futures Daycare Center
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Sarah Johnson, Director, Bright Futures Daycare Center, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Bright Futures Daycare Center, we provide a safe, nurturing, and stimulating environment for children aged six weeks to five years. Our core operations focus on delivering high-quality childcare services, adhering to state-mandated ratios to ensure individualized attention and care for each child. Our dedicated staff members are well-trained in child development, first aid, and emergency response, fostering a supportive atmosphere that encourages growth and learning.

We offer a variety of educational programs that promote cognitive, social, and emotional development, incorporating play-based learning and structured activities. Our facility is designed with child safety in mind, featuring secure entry systems and a well-maintained outdoor playground with age-appropriate equipment undergoing regular inspections. We prioritize health and hygiene, maintaining cleanliness throughout our facility to ensure a safe space for the children in our care.

Regular communication with parents is fundamental to our operations, providing updates on their child's progress and well-being. The center’s commitment to compliance with all licensing regulations and safety codes reflects our dedication to providing a secure and nurturing environment for every child.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a child at Bright Futures Daycare Center slipped and fell on a wet floor, resulting in a minor injury. The medical expenses amounted to $1,200, which have been fully paid. The incident has been reported to the parents and documented in our incident log. The center has since reinforced staff training on maintaining dry play areas and ensuring proper signage for wet floors. The status of this loss is closed.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Grade A, Fire-resistant vault suitable for securing sensitive documents and records.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secured entry systems with monitored access points, perimeter fencing, and regular safety patrols during operational hours.
